title: Expand singletons into pluses
written_solution: Every isolated nonzero cell grows into a plus of radius 1 in its own color: center plus the four cardinal neighbors.
program_solution:
(rule!
  (for/fold ([out g]) ([cell (in-list (filter (lambda (x) (not (= (third x) 0))) (grid-cells g)))])
    (let ((r (first cell)) (c (second cell)) (v (third cell)))
      (if (empty? (filter (lambda (d)
                            (let ((nr (+ r (first d))) (nc (+ c (second d))))
                              (and (in-bounds? nr nc (rows g) (cols g))
                                   (= (at g nr nc) v))))
                          cardinal-deltas))
          (paint-cells out
                       (filter (lambda (p) (in-bounds? (first p) (second p) (rows g) (cols g)))
                               (cons (list r c)
                                     (map (lambda (d) (list (+ r (first d)) (+ c (second d)))) cardinal-deltas)))
                       v)
          out))))
